author: Marlon Chaviano
name: obsidian-plugin
title: Obsidian plugin
description: An Obsidian plugin from the official template: commands, settings and views with the typed API, esbuild builds and reloading while you develop.
setupTasks: Obsidian: change `id`, `name` and `author` in `manifest.json` and link the folder into `<vault>/.obsidian/plugins/` to try it.
instructions:
## How to work here

- The plugin starts in `src/main.ts` (a class that extends `Plugin`): register commands with `this.addCommand()` and settings with `this.addSettingTab()`.
- Everything you register in `onload()` must clean itself up (`this.register*`), so disabling the plugin leaves nothing behind.
- Develop with `npm run dev` and the folder linked into your vault; reload Obsidian to see changes.
- Before finishing: `npm run build` (checks types and generates `main.js`).
